title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
abstract: arXiv:2611.34407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Datase

translated_title: 智能体瀑布：一种意图驱动的信息发现框架，在注意力经济中重新夺回用户控制权
translated_abstract: 我们形式化了"Agentic Waterfall Feed"（智能体瀑布信息流）这一新的个性化信息发现问题：在该问题中，用户主动引导推荐，而系统则根据从显式请求和浏览行为中推断出的不断演变的需求进行自适应调整。我们提出Agentic Waterfall框架来解决这一问题，该框架由语言模型控制器维护持久化的用户状态，并协调内容检索、排序和状态更新。为了在该任务上评估各系统，我们贡献了Agentic Waterfall数据集和一种基于回放的评估协议。该数据集将真实内容元数据与模拟交互历史相结合；该协议则在共享历史条件下比较各系统，使用相关性评分以及对推荐在多大程度上满足用户当前目标和约束的盲评判断。在五个公开基准的传统推荐任务上，Agentic Waterfall与强基线相比仍保持竞争力。在Agentic Waterfall数据集上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出"Agentic Waterfall"新框架，让用户主动引导个性化信息发现，由语言模型控制器维护持久用户状态并协调检索、排序与状态更新，同时贡献了配套数据集与基于回放的评估协议，在传统推荐基准上保持竞争力的同时将控制权还给用户。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new intent-driven information discovery problem, and proposes a framework with a language-model controller that maintains persistent user state to let users actively steer recommendations, contributing a dataset and replay-based evaluation protocol while remaining competitive with strong baselines across five public benchmarks.
